title: Clinical Trial Landscape
description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov with explicit bounded filters and organize registry records into a source-linked translational evidence landscape.

tools.name: clinical_trials_preview
tools.description: Preview up to ten source-ordered ClinicalTrials.gov records for a condition and optional intervention. Return registration status, phase, sponsor, design, endpoints, results availability, NCT IDs, and official links without treating registry metadata as efficacy evidence.

condition.description: Disease or condition term, preferably in English.

intervention.description: Optional drug, biologic, device, procedure, or other intervention term.

tools.name: clinical_trials_collect
tools.description: Collect and persist an approved ClinicalTrials.gov landscape with up to 30 registry records, exact filters, normalized trial metadata, NCT links, TSV, report, manifest, and interpretation limits.

tools.name: clinical_trial_results_preflight
tools.description: Resolve one exact NCT ID and verify that ClinicalTrials.gov has posted tabular results. Return study identity and bounded counts for outcomes, adverse-event terms, publications, and protocol documents without generating an effect conclusion.

nct_id.description: Exact ClinicalTrials.gov identifier, for example NCT02414854.

tools.name: clinical_trial_results_review
tools.description: Capture the posted participant flow, baseline, outcome values and submitted statistics, adverse events, protocol documents, and linked publications for one approved NCT record. Persist source-ordered TSV, JSON, manifest, and Markdown outputs without calculating an efficacy or safety score.
